title: setup.md says Quick setup is the last entry on the options first menu; Advanced settings follows it
claim: docs/setup.md:131 says that under Configure 'Quick setup is the last entry on the first menu', but the options flow's async_step_init shows 9 entries with quick_setup second from the end and 'advanced' (Advanced settings) last.
mechanism: async_step_init builds the menu from _TOP_MENU (eight pages ending in quick_setup) and then appends 'advanced'; the sentence counts the eight pages and forgets the Advanced settings entry the same menu ends with (README.md and configuration.md describe the two-menu layout correctly).

evidence.contention_note: box heavily loaded (load1 ~225); the value is deterministic

instrumented_symbol: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/config_flow.py:<options flow>.async_step_init (menu_options captured, translation lookup passed through)

perturbation.change: --perturb: the 'advanced' entry dropped from the shown menu in memory

null_control.note: the first entry the docs name ('Your system, as configured') is first, so the harness reads the order the docs describe

metric_definition: Position from the end of quick_setup among the menu_options async_step_init shows (1 = last, as the doc states).
phenomenon_property: A reader document's statement of menu order matches the order the options flow shows.
seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D5/s2/menu_order.py; grep -n -i 'last entry\|first entry' README.md docs/*.md
proposed_fix_scope: setup.md:131: 'the last of the eight pages on the first menu, just above Advanced settings'. For D6: the sentence.
